title: Not singing since, declining TV, and hiding her age
summary: She never sings or hums but kept her voice rested; she turned down TV partly because she did not want people to see how old she was at the hospital.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You know, it's remarkable how well you did in '61 when we made those albums. You would not think you had stopped singing.
Well, I tell you what, Chris. Do you know I never sing?

Never. I never even sing. I never even hum. Isn't that funny? But you know what, I never abused my voice. I've always gotten rest. I don't drink or smoke and never did. So I always preserved my health. Now, I can blurt out now, if you want me to.
Blurt out a little bit. I mean sing a song.
I'm sure you can. I'm sure you can. I know it.
Yes, Lord. And I've had so many offers to go in shows and to do TV. Do you remember, that ABC wanted me to be interviewed, you know?
And the different ones. But I don't know why. I just stopped singing.
Well, I always thought that one reason you didn't want to do TV interviews was because you were --
And I don't like to dress up.
-- hiding the fact that -- you know, that you didn't want people to know --
-- how old you were at the hospital. I always thought well, she didn't want them to see her.
That's the truth. You sure did guess it.
